Metadata.title: Safolio — Invest with insight
Metadata.description: Safolio is an independent platform that brings all your assets — stocks, crypto, ETFs, gold — together in one place, helping you make the right decisions through advanced risk analysis.

Hero.sub: Safolio is an independent platform that brings all your assets — stocks, crypto, ETFs, gold — together in one place, helping you manage them with ease and make the right decisions through advanced risk analysis.
Hero.ctaNote: Be among the first to try. No spam, ever.

Hero.trustA: Independent — not tied to any bank or broker

Features.sub: Safolio is more than just a portfolio tracker. It's your companion on the path to financial freedom — see the bigger picture, understand your risks, refine your strategy, and act with ease.
Features.f1_b: Not tied to any bank or broker. Every calculation and analysis is built for your benefit and trust.
Features.f2_b: From stocks to crypto, funds to gold, manage and evaluate all your investments in one place.
Features.f3_b: Learn from your past and plan your future. Track every move with the reason behind it, in the simplest way.
Features.f4_b: No surprises. Advanced tools work for you so you stay in control and enjoy managing your investments yourself.
Features.f5_b: Learn, share and grow together. A community of investors managing their own portfolios — no gurus, no signals.

Preview.h: A dashboard that shows what matters first.
Preview.sub: Designed around the questions investors actually ask: How am I doing? Where is my risk? What changed?

How.h: Set up in minutes. Use it for years.
How.s1_b: Add positions manually, via CSV, or by linking accounts. Your data, your control.
How.s2_b: Safolio normalises across asset classes and currencies, then surfaces risk you couldn't see before.
How.s3_b: Stress-test changes, journal your reasoning, and revisit your strategy with the data in front of you.

Personas.h: Wherever you are on your investment journey.
Personas.p1: New investors taking their very first steps into the world of investing
Personas.p2: Experienced investors and traders looking for smarter tools and deeper insights
Personas.p3: Those managing both crypto and traditional assets together
Personas.p4: Investment communities that love to share knowledge
Personas.p5: Savers who want to turn their money into investments with reliable insights
Personas.p6: Financial professionals seeking advanced analysis and clarity
Personas.p7: Thought leaders and influencers shaping the future of finance

Manifesto.p1: We believe investing is a right for everyone, no matter the size of their savings.
Manifesto.p2: Too many investors get lost in scattered platforms and overwhelming information. As investors ourselves, searching for the best way to grow our money, we built Safolio — a trustworthy, independent platform that empowers you to make your own decisions, backed by unbiased analysis and advanced risk insights.
Manifesto.p3: As you plan for your future, you're no longer alone. Safolio is with you 24/7, helping you take control and make the right moves on your investment journey.

CTA.sub: Forget what you thought you knew about finance — a new era is beginning, and this time, you're in control.
